title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks + quality-gating metrics integration
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: We need deterministic per-prompt regression checks to prevent subtle quality regressions when model families or prompt templates change. This PR introduces a new set of CI hooks that run the eval-harness per-prompt suites on PRs touching model prompts, prompt sets, or eval logic. It also integrates a lightweight metrics ingestion step that publishes per-prompt A/B metrics to the eval metrics bucket so that the quality-gating step can compare against a baseline.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml which runs a targeted eval job for changed prompt-sets and on-demand for hand-triggered runs.
- Implements eval-harness/ci/hooks/per_prompt_ci.py: a thin wrapper that loads changed prompt-sets from the PR, schedules per-prompt evals using the existing eval harness runner, and posts summary metrics to the eval metrics service.
- Adds eval-harness/config/prompt-set-ci.yaml to define default gating thresholds (pass/fail for each prompt category).
- Adds a gating step in the checkout pipeline that fails the PR when prompt-level regressions exceed threshold for configured signals (qa_score_delta, rouge_l_drop, factuality_drop).
- Small doc and test additions: docs/eval-harness/ci.md and tests/test_per_prompt_ci.py.

Usage notes / How it works:
- Only runs on PRs that change files under eval-harness/prompt-sets/ or changes to eval-harness/runner/*.
- By default the job runs a fast sample of 50 examples per prompt, configurable via prompt-set-ci.yaml and per-PR labels (e.g., "ci/full-eval").
- Metrics are uploaded as CSV to s3://redwood-eval-metrics/<sha>/per-prompt.csv and the gating step queries the baseline for the most recent merged commit on main.
- Fallback behavior: if metrics baseline is missing we mark the gating check as "warning" rather than hard-fail and surface to the PR check to avoid blocking onboarding.

Testing done:
- Local unit tests for per_prompt_ci wrapper (tests/test_per_prompt_ci.py).
- End-to-end smoke in a fork with a synthetic prompt-set change; initial CI run failed (missing env var), fix pushed in second commit and GH Actions passed.
- Manual validation of metric upload and gating logic against the staging metrics bucket.

Rollout:
- Feature flagged behind ENV EVAL_PER_PROMPT_CI (defaults off in staging; enabled for ops team during rollout).
- Docs updated with runbook and remediation steps.

Related tickets: ENG-1789, QA-412, SUP-9981

release_notes: Add per-prompt CI hooks and quality gating for eval-harness (configurable thresholds and metric uploads).
notes_for_ops: Enable EVAL_PER_PROMPT_CI in staging first. If a large number of warnings appear, run the 'ci/full-eval' label on the PR to get the full sample set before triage.
